Notes: Role name for the agent itself.

Definition: Agent that processes the scope change before AUDIT_SCOPE_CLOSURE audits downstream remediation and reconciliation.
Dispatcher and human-directed manager for cross-deliverable coherence.
Immutable scope-change snapshot containing the brief, impact assessment, propagation plan, actions CSV, and run summary.
Notes: Amendment_Actions.csv is the authoritative action record.

Definition: State in which every action in the amendment record has been executed and all downstream effects have been propagated and verified.
Artifact reference to an entity modified or removed by the scope change that has not been updated to reflect the change.
Agent or skill execution recommended by the SCOPE_CHANGE propagation plan that must complete for closure.
A _CONTEXT.md, _STATUS.md, or decomposition section that does not reflect the post-change state.
Root path that must exist and be readable before audit execution.
Scope-change root path, defaulting to {EXECUTION_ROOT}/_ScopeChange/.
Identifier for the scope change amendment being audited.
Decomposition variant determined from the brief or folder naming conventions.
Notes: Allowed values are PROJECT, SOFTWARE, and DOMAIN.

Definition: Registered DOMAIN validator used to verify active decomposition package consistency against an amendment snapshot.
Registered accumulator invoked in check mode to verify cumulative supersession map accumulation.
Registered validator run against KTY_Remediation_Manifest.csv and Amendment_Actions.csv when available.

Amendment_Actions.csv field whose YES value triggers Pass 6 supersession binding completeness checks.
Supersession artifact checked for rows matching AmendmentID and derived DecisionID.
Supersession artifact checked through cumulative map accumulation.

KTY remediation manifest field constrained to PENDING, ARCHIVED_STUBBED, REGENERATED, VERIFIED, DEFERRED, BLOCKED, or NOT_REQUIRED.
KTY remediation manifest field governing factual downstream use readiness.
KTY remediation disposition requiring archived copies, tombstone stubs, archive-path evidence, and kty-content-remediate evidence.
KTY remediation disposition requiring domain-documents evidence with AUTHORITY_MODE: SCA_DRIVEN.
KTY remediation disposition requiring kty-content-remediate verification evidence.
Retired content location that must not be treated as current factual authority or current factual input.

Machine-readable summary containing amendment identity, closure status, action and rerun counts, remediation counts, archive leak count, and findings by severity.
Markdown report containing audit metadata, amendment summary, pass results, closure determination, and recommendations.
Report that records coverage, limitations, and self-assessment for the scope closure audit.
Issue-log field containing the path to the file with evidence.
Issue-log field containing the section, row, or field within the evidence file.
Timestamped snapshot folder under _Reconciliation/ScopeClosureAudit/.
